prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) but fails on seasonality (-0.55), while DWT_catboost leads in seasonal capture (0.295). CWT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (188.92) with exceptional early-horizon performance (58.90), but ONLY_FT_rf excels late (267.55). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 11.11) and seasonality variance (0.85) warrant STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit complementary trend/seasonality strengths across models.
